rules.rationale: Isotonic crystalloids are recommended for volume expansion in patients at risk for or with AKI.
rules.citation: 3.1.1: Use isotonic [SNOMED: 16709005] crystalloids rather than colloids (albumin [SNOMED: 52454007] or starches) for volume expansion in patients at risk for or with AKI [SNOMED: 14669001] (2B).

rules.rationale: Vasopressors should be used alongside fluids in vasomotor shock.
rules.citation: 3.1.2: Use vasopressors [SNOMED: 870406003] alongside fluids in vasomotor shock [SNOMED: 27942005] (1C).

rules.rationale: Protocol-based hemodynamic management is recommended in perioperative high-risk patients.
rules.citation: 3.1.3: Use protocol [SNOMED: 258049002]-based hemodynamic management in perioperative high-risk patients (2C) or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007] (2C).

rules.rationale: Protocol-based hemodynamic management is recommended in septic shock.
rules.citation: 3.1.3: Use protocol [SNOMED: 258049002]-based hemodynamic management in perioperative high-risk patients (2C) or septic shock [SNOMED: 76571007] (2C).

rules.rationale: Target plasma glucose should be 110–149 mg/dl in critically ill patients.
rules.citation: 3.3.1: Target plasma glucose [SNOMED: 72191006] 110–149 mg/dl [SNOMED: 258797006] (6.1–8.3 mmol [SNOMED: 258718000]/l) in critically ill patients (2C).

rules.rationale: Total energy intake should be 20–30 kcal/kg/d.
rules.citation: 3.3.2: Achieve total energy intake [SNOMED: 787787004] of 20–30 kcal [SNOMED: 258791007]/kg/d [SNOMED: 258831001] (2C).

rules.rationale: Protein intake recommendations vary based on dialysis status and catabolic state.
rules.citation: 3.3.4: Administer [SNOMED: 738990001] 0.8–1.0 g/kg/d [SNOMED: 414306004] protein [SNOMED: 88878007] in noncatabolic non-dialyzed AKI, 1.0–1.5 g/kg/d [SNOMED: 414306004] on RRT, and up to 1.7 g/kg/d [SNOMED: 414306004] on CRRT [SNOMED: 714749008]/hypercatabolic patients (2D).

rules.rationale: Diuretics are NOT recommended for prevention of AKI.
rules.citation: 3.4.1: Recommend NOT using diuretics [SNOMED: 372695000] to prevent AKI [SNOMED: 14669001] (1B).

rules.rationale: Diuretics are generally NOT recommended for treatment of AKI, except for volume overload.
rules.citation: 3.4.2: Suggest NOT using diuretics [SNOMED: 372695000] to treat AKI [SNOMED: 14669001], except to manage volume overload [SNOMED: 21639008] (2C).

rules.rationale: Low-dose dopamine is NOT recommended for prevention or treatment of AKI.
rules.citation: 3.5.1: Recommend NOT using low-dose [SNOMED: 262459003] dopamine [SNOMED: 412383006] to prevent or treat AKI [SNOMED: 14669001] (1A).
